CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2605 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 5a3c5d2395043b7ce9f82b383be350356c9d5864. Bus nonce: 8cb0599cdfd5ab2d2f2c84e292448039. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 5a3c5d2395043b7ce9f82b383be350356c9d5864`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 5a3c5d2395043b7ce9f82b383be350356c9d5864` or `Fix review: blocked 5a3c5d2395043b7ce9f82b383be350356c9d5864 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 8cb0599cdfd5ab2d2f2c84e292448039`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `5a3c5d2395043b7ce9f82b383be350356c9d5864` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2605 5a3c5d2395043b7ce9f82b383be350356c9d5864") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2605-8cb0599c`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Round-2 re-review of PR #2605 (R10-NIGHTLY-PYSPY-RETRY) at head 5a3c5d2395043b7ce9f82b383be350356c9d5864; code 7bd9c8f3e. Round 1 was blocked mutation-vacuous at 7651b942: `git fetch origin review/2605 && git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md` (f00094d17). PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required:
- Every round-1 Block and Finding is settled. Re-run X1 (rest sleep to pass), X2 (PY_SPY_TIMEOUT_S=25.0), X3 (HB_CONTROL_TRIES=2) and X5 (default spy_timeout=30.0): each must go red in tests/entities.py, or the body must give a sound reason its value is free. Re-run the PR's mutant harness, and add one hand mutant of your own outside its list.
- The pinned whole-control bound matches the body's figure. The code comment at nightly_ha.py:289-291 now says that the fresh-spin retry was measured not to rescue (F7).
- The check keeps its power: a stub that never answers, or answers without naming the spin, still fails hb:positive_control.
- The residual is carried to R10-NIGHTLY-HB-RESPAWN, which lands in roster PR #2608 (handoff/audit-r10-roster aa38bdd5f, op 7ab485ae9). Run `carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check` over the body: 0 unrouted. The orchestrator added the roster path to the Forward-carry line, the only edit made to the fixer's body.
- Re-derive every figure. git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 5a3c5d2395043b7ce9f82b383be350356c9d5864 must be clean. Read check-runs. A red from "API rate limit exceeded" or a missing /tmp/pr-body.md is external. nightly-status and delivery-status are not required.
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head, and VERDICT carries bus-nonce: 8cb0599cdfd5ab2d2f2c84e292448039. No /Users/ or /private/ path may appear in VERDICT.md or ev/.
